# Facelets layout: 54 stickers in URFDLB face order, each face row-major per the Kociemba net.
# Hand-written, not generated by the code under test.
#
# How to read it: the cube is unfolded with F facing you. U is above F with its B edge on top,
# D is below F with its F edge on top, and L F R B sit in a row, each with its U edge on top.
# Each block below is three rows of U, three rows of L F R B side by side, then three rows of D.
#
# [indices] gives each cell's index in Facelets.colors: face.ordinal * 9 + row * 3 + col,
# so U = 0..8, R = 9..17, F = 18..26, D = 27..35, L = 36..44, B = 45..53.
#
# [solved] gives the solved cube in the home frame: W(hite) U, R(ed) R, G(reen) F,
# Y(ellow) D, O(range) L, B(lue) B.
